reason: The indexed C-centered monoclinic cell, primitive volume (179.605 A^3), Z=1 in the primitive cell, and a Li/Fe/Si/O tetrahedral average framework are reasonably supported, but exact recovery is not. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the trajectory optimized extracted stick intensities with chemistry restraints rather than demonstrating a conventional full-profile refinement; an independent Gaussian profile check of the submitted CIFs gives normalized profile RMS values of about 0.30-0.32. Both final models are unconstrained P1 structures with no detected higher symmetry even at 0.2 A tolerance and retain physically concerning Fe-O shells, including 1.625 A in selected.cif and 1.601 A in alternative-1.cif plus irregular/undercoordinated longer contacts. The two CIFs are also StructureMatcher-equivalent and have highly correlated calculated intensities, so they do not cover a materially distinct symmetry, framework, or element-ordering alternative. The trace tested C2/m, P-1, and C2, but the accepted coordinates arose from only two vacancy variants of one Li2FeSiO4-derived parent and depended strongly on ad hoc extinction and Si-O restraint weights. Thus the diffraction supports the lattice much more strongly than the submitted symmetry, coordinates, occupancies/order, and another scientifically motivated solution attempt is warranted.
